description: Velora's five starting lands plus the Realm Beyond. Velora relationships are political and cultural, not permanent moral alignments. An Avari's region influences reputation and story opportunities — it does not prevent friendships, travel, or collecting Arcori. The Realm Beyond sits outside that map and has no affinities or hostilities.

centralConflict.summary: Ashdrift Hill and Everlight Grove disagree over whether the mystery beneath the falling ash should be contained, extinguished or left untouched.

alliances.name: The Veiled Accord
alliances.purpose: Cooperate in studying lost memories and places that appear only briefly.

alliances.name: The Living Pact
alliances.purpose: Defend living wilderness and ancient forces.

regions.name: Ashdrift Hill
regions.loreDescription:
Ash falls endlessly across Ashdrift Hill, although no fire or volcano has ever been found. Roads disappear beneath pale drifts, abandoned structures emerge without warning, and distant figures sometimes appear through the grey before vanishing again.

The people of Ashdrift believe the falling ash is the remains of memories that Velora could not preserve. Others claim something beneath the hill is still burning—but no Chronicle confirms what it might be.

identity.summary: silence, obscured memories, psychological mystery and forgotten ruins

MWB.label: Affinity
MWB.reason: Both study places and memories that appear only briefly. Their pathfinders regularly exchange discoveries.

AMB.label: Neutral
AMB.reason: Both preserve the past differently: Ashdrift lets memories fall and fade; Amberwild traps them in amber. They remain curious but distant.

LFR.label: Neutral
LFR.reason: Their harsh climates create mutual understanding, but neither region entirely trusts the other's strange disappearances and recoveries.

EVG.label: Hostility
EVG.reason: Everlight believes something beneath Ashdrift threatens Velora. Ashdrift considers Everlight's attempted interventions an invasion.

regions.name: Everlight Grove
regions.loreDescription:
Everlight Grove is a bright, energetic land where enormous trees grow around ancient pillars of coloured light. Each pillar shines differently, but when danger threatens the Grove, their separate colours converge into a single radiant force.

Old carvings depict groups of guardians standing beside colossal animal-shaped figures. Whether these were creatures, machines or symbolic protectors has been forgotten. The light continues to choose new defenders whenever the Grove needs them.

identity.summary: teamwork, transformation, colourful energy and ancient guardians

AMB.label: Affinity
AMB.reason: The Grove's guardians protect Amberwild's living wilderness, while Amberwild provides ancient knowledge and materials.

LFR.label: Favourable
LFR.reason: Everlight repeatedly assists Little Frost after its inexplicable disasters. Little Frost appreciates the help but mocks Everlight's ceremony.

MWB.label: Tension
MWB.reason: Everlight wants dangerous discoveries secured; Moonwake believes forgotten places must remain open to exploration.

ASH.label: Hostility
ASH.reason: Everlight believes something beneath Ashdrift threatens Velora. Ashdrift considers Everlight's attempted interventions an invasion.

regions.name: Little Frost
regions.loreDescription:
Little Frost is a remote settlement surrounded by snowy mountains and seemingly trapped in permanent winter. Its colourful houses, modest streets and cheerful residents make it appear peaceful—until something strange inevitably happens.

Monsters, visitors, unexplained disasters and ridiculous disputes are treated as normal inconveniences. Buildings may be destroyed one day and stand untouched the next morning. No one agrees whether the town heals itself or simply refuses to remember what happened.

identity.summary: snowy small-town life, absurdity, dark comedy and recurring chaos

EVG.label: Favourable
EVG.reason: Everlight repeatedly assists Little Frost after its inexplicable disasters. Little Frost appreciates the help but mocks Everlight's ceremony.

MWB.label: Favourable
MWB.reason: Traders cross the frozen routes between them. Both cultures are comfortable living beside unexplained phenomena.

ASH.label: Neutral
ASH.reason: Their harsh climates create mutual understanding, but neither region entirely trusts the other's strange disappearances and recoveries.

AMB.label: Tension
AMB.reason: Amberwild considers Little Frost careless and destructive. Little Frost sees Amberwild's preservation customs as overly serious and restrictive.

regions.name: Moonwake Bay
regions.loreDescription:
Moonwake Bay lies along a luminous coast where the sea glows beneath the moon. When the tide retreats, it reveals pathways, Arcori markings and fragments of structures that do not appear on any map.

Sailors believe the moon pulls more than water from the bay—it draws forgotten places close to Velora. Some ruins remain exposed for minutes; others endure for generations. Those who follow the lights beneath the waves do not always return to the same shore.

identity.summary: ocean mystery, moonlit exploration, lost places and changing tides

ASH.label: Affinity
ASH.reason: Both study places and memories that appear only briefly. Their pathfinders regularly exchange discoveries.

LFR.label: Favourable
LFR.reason: Traders cross the frozen routes between them. Both cultures are comfortable living beside unexplained phenomena.

EVG.label: Tension
EVG.reason: Everlight wants dangerous discoveries secured; Moonwake believes forgotten places must remain open to exploration.

AMB.label: Tension
AMB.reason: They dispute relics uncovered where the changing shoreline meets Amberwild territory.

regions.name: Amberwild
regions.loreDescription:
Amberwild is a vast golden wilderness of sunlit grasslands, dense forests and towering amber formations. Within the amber rest shapes resembling extinct creatures, unfamiliar objects and moments seemingly frozen in time.

The land feels ancient, yet new discoveries appear after every great storm. Some believe Amberwild preserves memories before they can fade. Others warn that the amber is not preserving its inhabitants—it is waiting to release them.

identity.summary: wilderness, ancient life, preserved moments, exploration and awakening

EVG.label: Affinity
EVG.reason: The Grove's guardians protect Amberwild's living wilderness, while Amberwild provides ancient knowledge and materials.

ASH.label: Neutral
ASH.reason: Both preserve the past differently: Ashdrift lets memories fall and fade; Amberwild traps them in amber. They remain curious but distant.

MWB.label: Tension
MWB.reason: They dispute relics uncovered where the changing shoreline meets Amberwild territory.

LFR.label: Tension
LFR.reason: Amberwild considers Little Frost careless and destructive. Little Frost sees Amberwild's preservation customs as overly serious and restrictive.

regions.name: Realm Beyond
regions.loreDescription:
The Realm Beyond is not a land of Velora. Chronicles say the veil between them was once so thin that every laugh, hope and act of wonder echoed freely — remembered only as The Bright Time. Then the echoes faded. The Realm Beyond grew heavier, and the First Hands found themselves unable to return.

What still crosses the veil does so without treaty or feud. The Realm Beyond holds no affinities and no hostilities. It is the unanswered elsewhere every generation inherits.

identity.summary: beyond the veil, First Hands, echoes that outlive their origin, no political standing
